title: Exterior view of campus buildings, distant hills and communications tower
objects_and_counts: Foreground: multiple multi-storey buildings are visible; at least four distinct building facades can be counted across the frame (a leftmost glass-faced tower, a white/grey rectangular building with many windows, a central tan/buff brick building, and a right-side light-grey industrial building).
At least one vehicle is visible: a white car is parked near the mid-ground just left of the centre building (partially visible between buildings and trees).
Distant objects on the ridge: one tall communications tower with red-and-white horizontal bands sits on a hill in the right half of the image.
Vegetation: a continuous treeline/wooded area spans the mid-ground across the image; numerous individual trees are visible but not individually counted.
Sky elements: multiple clouds of varying sizes are visible in the upper half of the image.

Windows: many repeated windows are visible on the white/grey building (arranged in rows) and on the tan building (single narrow windows stacked vertically); an exact count of total windows across all façades cannot be reliably determined from this single view.
spatial_relations: A glass-faced tower building occupies the far left edge of the image; immediately right of it is a white/grey rectangular building with horizontally aligned windows.
A tan/buff brick building stands in front of and slightly to the right of the white/grey building; its narrow vertical windows are visible on the face that faces the camera.
Behind the foreground building cluster, a strip of wooded hills extends across the mid-ground and separates the buildings from more distant blue mountains.
The red-and-white communications tower sits on a hill in the right half of the image, above the treeline and below the sky.
A low, light-grey industrial-style building with a metal roof is in the lower right quadrant in front of the wooded area.
The white car is located near the central lower-mid area, between the buildings and partially obscured by trees.
